hook_angle: offer-first with a playful benefit question
visual_layout: sale banner: open jelly-cream jar spilling over a second jar, struck-through price vs sale price tags, starburst countdown badge, diagonal Shop Now strip
cta_style: shop now (on-image strip) with countdown urgency
color_palette: hot pink, crimson red, black, white; loud, urgent, juicy
risk_notes: relies on a countdown ('Sale ends in 4 hours') that must be genuine; 'young, bouncy skin' implies an anti-ageing result
why_it_works: Price anchor (struck-through old price beside a big new one) makes the saving instant, and the countdown adds urgency. The glossy spilling gel shows texture so the deal still sells the product.

advertised_product.name: Conscious Chemist Lift Me Up Collagen Jelly Cream
